deals.travelWindow: Sep 29 cheapest confirmed date, nonstop JetBlue; American also flies the route nonstop
deals.whyRanked: The cheapest verified fare of the five at $115 RT nonstop, and Niagara Falls State Park — the oldest state park in the US — is a 25-minute drive from downtown.
deals.soloWhy: Downtown Buffalo's Elmwood Village and Canalside are small and walkable, and Niagara's Goat Island trails are well-trafficked and easy to explore solo.

highlights: Niagara Falls State Park: American, Bridal Veil, and Horseshoe Falls viewpoints
Cave of the Winds boardwalk (get soaked at the base of the falls)
Maid of the Mist boat tour
Elmwood Village for shops and cafes
Canalside on the Buffalo waterfront
itinerary: Day 1 — Land, walk Elmwood Village, dinner at a Buffalo wing joint, evening stroll at Canalside.
Day 2 — Drive to Niagara Falls State Park: Goat Island trails, Cave of the Winds, and the Maid of the Mist boat tour; stay for the nightly falls illumination.
Day 3 — Whirlpool State Park for the Niagara Gorge rim trail, or the Buffalo AKG Art Museum before an afternoon flight.
guide.gettingAround: Downtown Buffalo is walkable; rent a car for the 25-minute drive to Niagara Falls (no rideshare needed once there — the park's shuttle covers the overlooks).
guide.stayArea: Elmwood Village or downtown Buffalo — walkable, with easy highway access to the falls.
food: Anchor Bar (birthplace of the Buffalo wing)

deals.travelWindow: Late Aug – Sep, cheapest nonstop (Frontier); United/Delta nonstop fares run higher into fall
deals.whyRanked: $152 RT nonstop is a fresh Frontier floor, and Rocky Mountain National Park is 90 minutes away via Estes Park.
deals.soloWhy: The A Line train runs straight from DEN into downtown, City Park and the Cherry Creek Trail are easy solo walks, and Red Rocks shows draw a crowd used to solo concertgoers.

highlights: Denver Botanic Gardens
Denver Art Museum and Civic Center Park
Red Rocks Amphitheatre (check the summer show calendar)
City Park and the Denver Zoo
Cherry Creek Trail for a morning run or bike
itinerary: Day 1 — A Line into downtown, Denver Art Museum and Civic Center Park, dinner in the Highlands.
Day 2 — Denver Botanic Gardens in the morning, Cherry Creek Trail by bike in the afternoon, a Red Rocks show at night if the calendar lines up.
Day 3 — Rent a car for Rocky Mountain NP: the Bear Lake corridor for an easy alpine hike, back to Denver for an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: A Line train covers the airport-to-downtown hop; you'll want a rental car for Red Rocks, Boulder, or the national park.
guide.stayArea: Highlands or Cherry Creek — walkable, close to trails and restaurants.

deals.travelWindow: Sep – Nov, $178 RT connecting (Frontier) floor; nonstop JetBlue/Southwest fares run $241-259
deals.whyRanked: $178 RT is the connecting-flight floor, and the French Quarter is one of the most solo-friendly historic districts in the country — no park nearby, but the price and the solo score both earn it a spot.
deals.soloWhy: The French Quarter and Garden District are compact and walkable, counter-seating po'boy shops and courtyard bars make solo dining easy, and the streetcar removes any need for a car.

highlights: French Quarter: Jackson Square, St. Louis Cathedral, Bourbon and Royal Streets
Garden District mansions via the St. Charles streetcar
National WWII Museum
Frenchmen Street live music (locals' alternative to Bourbon St.)
City Park and the New Orleans Museum of Art
itinerary: Day 1 — Walk the French Quarter: Jackson Square, the Cabildo, Royal Street galleries, dinner and jazz on Frenchmen Street.
Day 2 — St. Charles streetcar to the Garden District for the mansions and Lafayette Cemetery, National WWII Museum in the afternoon.
Day 3 — City Park and the New Orleans Museum of Art, or a swamp tour day trip before an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: The French Quarter and Garden District are walkable, and the St. Charles streetcar covers the rest of the historic core — no car needed.
guide.stayArea: French Quarter (for nightlife) or the Garden District (for quiet) — both walkable and streetcar-connected.

deals.whyRanked: $193-199 RT nonstop, and Fort De Soto Park's beaches and the Gulf coast are a short drive from a walkable downtown.
deals.soloWhy: Riverwalk and Hyde Park are walkable and safe for an evening stroll, but a rental car or rideshare is worth it for the Gulf beaches.

highlights: Tampa Riverwalk
Ybor City's Cuban heritage and nightlife
Fort De Soto Park beaches and fort ruins
Florida Aquarium
Clearwater Beach or St. Pete day trip
itinerary: Day 1 — Walk the Riverwalk, Florida Aquarium, dinner and cigars in Ybor City.
Day 2 — Rent a car for Fort De Soto Park: the beach and the Spanish-American War fort ruins, sunset at the north beach.
Day 3 — Day trip to St. Pete for the Dali Museum and Central Avenue murals, or Clearwater Beach before an afternoon flight.
guide.gettingAround: The TECO Line streetcar connects downtown to Ybor City; a rental car is needed for the beaches and Fort De Soto.
guide.stayArea: Downtown or Hyde Park — walkable, close to the Riverwalk and streetcar.

deals.whyRanked: The priciest of the five at $259 RT nonstop, but Big Cottonwood and Little Cottonwood Canyons are 30 minutes from downtown, with Zion and Arches both reachable on a longer day trip.
deals.soloWhy: Downtown and the Temple Square area are compact and walkable, the TRAX light rail reaches the canyons' trailhead shuttles, and the hiking culture makes it easy to join a group trail.

highlights: Temple Square and the Utah State Capitol
Big Cottonwood Canyon: Donut Falls or Lake Blanche trail
Antelope Island State Park bison herd
Red Butte Garden
Liberty Park and the Tracy Aviary
itinerary: Day 1 — Temple Square, the Capitol, dinner in the Central 9th neighborhood.
Day 2 — Rent a car for Big Cottonwood Canyon: hike to Donut Falls or Lake Blanche, back downtown for a brewery dinner.
Day 3 — Antelope Island State Park for bison and lake views, or push further for a long Zion or Arches day trip if you have the hours.
guide.gettingAround: TRAX light rail covers downtown and the airport; a rental car is essential for the canyons and any national park day trip.
guide.stayArea: Downtown near Temple Square — walkable, close to TRAX and restaurants.
